title: Install and invoke a skill safely
steps: Inspect the manifest, files, source, version and required capabilities.
Choose manual or agent-selectable invocation scope.
Install a validated version into the trusted store.
Resolve template variables and preview the draft and permission envelope.
Invoke deliberately; execution still uses effective grants.
complete_when: versioned instructions are attributed and execution still uses effective grants (p.185).
traceability: p.185; controls S-01..S-06, S-14, I-06; acceptance A10, A23.
